entries.claim: The referenced shared formula supplies the 21 conclusion words w022–w042 and the separate Amen w043. Lowercase r. formats an initial, while uppercase R. marks a response; neither prefix is a Latin token.

The pinned Mass file supplies the 21-word body and its own explicit reference to the shared conclusion. The separately identified Ordo/Prayers use supplies the conclusion and response. The raw binding declares their complete ordered derivation.

The final secret has an audible Per omnia saecula saeculorum followed by the response Amen. Collects and postcommunions are priestly orations with a separate response. These rules determine the modeled boundaries, not the completeness of a date-specific commemoration inventory.

locator.section: RG 115 a; expanded conclusion w022–w042 and textual Amen w043

entries.claim: General rubric 115 a prints the Father-directed conclusion and Amen. It supplies w022–w043 after expansion of the printed abbreviation. The witness declares house accents, ligatures, tuum: Qui and separate response punctuation; response role is supported separately by ritual evidence.

The Benziger page prints the 21-word body (w001–w021) and the abbreviation Per Dóminum. The separately identified RG 115 a use supplies the expanded conclusion and Amen; these are not directly printed on p. 335.
